newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks hold losses in technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks hold losses in technical correction.

text.p: (1050 GMT) Madrid stocks hold losses at midday on Friday, as profit-taking corrected previous days' gains amid low volume ahead of the week-end.

But traders said that squaring books before Saturday and Sunday did not meant any change in the bullish underlying mood of the Madrid bourse. One of them said they had seen foreign investors stock picking.
* General Index was down 4.58 points, or 0.76 pct, to 599.11
* Ibex-35 index shed 31.3 points, or 0.46 pct, to 6,903.46
* Popular outpaced index, climbing 4.01 percent to 36,600
* Telefonica was 25 pesetas down to 4,350. Repsol 40 to 6,250
"The market is suffering a technical correction but there is no change in the underlying trend medium-term," a trader said.
"Foreign investors are picking up retailers, banks and few real estate firms," a Madrid-based dealer said.
But beside the buoyant Popular, banking shares which recently had experienced brisk gains, were punished with losses of around one percent.
Endesa was outperforming market, up 20 pesetas to 12,120.
